parsed.rationale: The second participating record resides at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift', which sits under the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory — a canonical sample-app path. Per the restraint rules, any record under Examples/ or SampleApp/ triggers a sample-app-mirror no-action regardless of the is_sample_app flag value. The duplication of 'MetricRow.body' in the sample app is almost certainly an intentional local copy that lets the sample app stand alone without a hard dependency on the production 'DebugPanel' package. Extracting shared code here would couple the production 'DebugPanel' package to sample-app demonstration semantics, which is the exact anti-pattern the restraint rule is designed to prevent.
